invariants.statement: The candidate serves only same-origin HTML, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, images, and authored data; runtime requests to www.tripit.com, TrustArc, Google, CDNs, telemetry, or any remote origin are forbidden.
acceptance_obligations: Release network evidence records zero non-same-origin requests across every acceptance journey and every checkpoint render.
The asset manifest marks remote_runtime_policy=forbidden and every referenced asset resolves from the local mirror.

invariants.statement: All server and client time derives from the frozen clock 2026-08-04T09:00:00-04:00 (America/New_York); no wall clock or randomness reaches rendering, sorting, datepicker defaults, or adapter outputs.
acceptance_obligations: Two renders of any state separated by wall-clock time are byte-identical outside user-driven mutations.
Datepicker defaults, relative-date copy, and adapter outputs are pure functions of the frozen clock and seed.

invariants.statement: Every acceptance-eligible checkpoint binds a sha256-frozen source frame, a viewport, a comparison region, the pixel-mae-similarity-v1 metric, and a threshold derived from pre-candidate 3-frame calibration; thresholds and ignore regions were frozen before any candidate render existed.
acceptance_obligations: Visual acceptance recomputes similarity against the frozen artifact whose sha256 matches the contract and passes the calibrated threshold for the full region and every region contract.
No ignore region exists in any frozen contract; any future mask requires a new freeze decision recorded before comparison.

invariants.statement: Authenticated and Pro surfaces carry evidence_kind=unavailable; the clone implements them as declared local contracts and no visual acceptance is claimed against pixels that were never captured. A later authenticated capture round may upgrade evidence without weakening anonymous contracts.
acceptance_obligations: No checkpoint with evidence_kind=unavailable is acceptance_eligible and no visual similarity score is reported for such surfaces.
The final report lists every unavailable family and the Steel Live View path that upgrades it.

invariants.statement: Identity resolves only from the server-side session referenced by the __Host-websitebench-tripit-session cookie; client-supplied account, owner, role, or subject fields are never trusted.
acceptance_obligations: Requests carrying forged account/owner/role fields resolve to the session subject or fail; no test can switch subjects without a new server session.
Sign-out invalidates the session row and protected routes redirect to sign-in afterwards.

invariants.statement: Exactly two auth mail purposes exist (registration, password-reset); their secret codes are issued transiently, never persisted in cleartext, and business mails (share-invite, import-receipt, trip-update, pro-receipt) never carry secrets.
acceptance_obligations: runtime.json mail purposes equal exactly {registration, password-reset} for auth and the four business purposes; the validator passes.
No cleartext secret code exists in any database row, log, or business mail body during the full suite.

invariants.statement: Trips, plans, documents, imports, notifications, and subscriptions are owner-scoped; foreign access returns 403/404 without existence disclosure and foreign mutations change nothing.
acceptance_obligations: other@example.com receives 403/404 for every traveler-owned resource URL and its mutation attempts leave row counts and contents unchanged.
Anonymous requests to owner-scoped routes redirect to sign-in without disclosing resource existence.

invariants.statement: Itinerary rows order by (start_ts_utc, sort_key, id); lodging expands to check-in/check-out rows and car to pick-up/drop-off rows; ordering is stable across refresh, restart, and reset.
acceptance_obligations: The seeded New York itinerary renders the anchor hotel between the outbound flight and later plans immediately after save, after refresh, and after restart.
A golden ordering test over the seeded dataset pins the exact row sequence per trip including expanded lodging/car rows.

invariants.statement: The anchor hotel add resolves May 23-26 to 2027 solely by date-overlap with the seeded New York trip and always joins that trip; it never creates a new trip.
acceptance_obligations: After the anchor journey the trip count for traveler@example.com is unchanged and the lodging row belongs to the seeded New York trip id.
Duplicate submission and the fixture import variant leave exactly one Hilton lodging row.

invariants.statement: Import messages are fingerprinted with sha256(from+subject+normalized body) under UNIQUE(owner, fingerprint); duplicates return the existing record (parse_status=duplicate) and never create a second plan; updates and cancellations mutate the originally imported plan.
acceptance_obligations: Re-injecting any fixture yields parse_status=duplicate with identical plan counts before and after.
The update fixture mutates the original plan row in place and the cancel fixture flips its status to canceled without deleting history.

invariants.statement: Pro checkout uses the local sandbox (exactly approved/declined/retryable scenarios) or per-site Stripe test mode behind the shared edge verifier; webhook handling trusts only the verified header, re-fetches the session server-side, and the ledger's one-active-approval index makes duplicate webhooks unable to double-activate. Live keys are structurally rejected; the hotel-entry path never touches payment code.
acceptance_obligations: An unverified webhook POST returns 400 and creates no subscription; duplicate verified webhooks leave exactly one active subscription row.
runtime.json validation rejects any non sk_test_/whsec_ credential shape and the anchor hotel flow's code path imports no payment module.

invariants.statement: Committed state survives process restart; the token-gated admin reset restores the exact seed manifest (physical SQLite rows) and is idempotent.
acceptance_obligations: seed-reset.exact-reseed, seed-reset.idempotent-repeat, and seed-reset.restart-round-trip pass with entity counts equal to the frozen manifest.
Reset without the admin token is rejected and mutates nothing.

invariants.statement: Documents are stored as size-bounded BLOB rows in the site SQLite file; oversize uploads fail with the frozen error state and the single database file carries the complete site state.
acceptance_obligations: Uploaded documents round-trip byte-identically through preview/download and survive restart; migration-copy evidence shows the single sqlite file carries them.
An oversize upload returns the frozen error state and adds no row.

invariants.statement: Share roles are exactly viewer/editor/traveler with a show_sensitive flag; sensitive fields are masked for shares without it; revocation is immediate; invite tokens are stored only as digests.
acceptance_obligations: A parameterized role-matrix test proves viewer read-only, editor mutation rights, sensitive-field masking without show_sensitive, and immediate loss of access on revoke.
No cleartext invite token exists in any database row; acceptance uses the tokenized link exactly once.
